verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench is a software tool suite (Document Driver, Capital and Liquidation Calculators), so asking about versioned APIs is a fair question. However, the evidence pack contains no documented API, versioning scheme or deprecation policy. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
